pattern.description: A regex pattern to match against request content

GuardrailInterval.description: Interval at which the limit resets (daily, weekly, monthly)

PromptInjectionScanScope.description: Which message roles to scan for prompt injection. Only applies to the regex-prompt-injection builtin. Defaults to all_messages.

example.name: My New Guardrail

allowed_data_regions.description: Data regions through which requests governed by this guardrail must arrive. `global` is https://openrouter.ai, `europe` is https://eu.openrouter.ai, and `us` is https://us.openrouter.ai. Requests arriving through any other region are rejected. `null` leaves the ingress region unrestricted. When several guardrails apply (workspace default, member, API key), the effective regions are the intersection of every non-null value. An empty array is rejected.

allowed_models.description: Array of model identifiers (slug or canonical_slug accepted)

content_filter_builtins.description: Builtin content filters to apply. Every builtin slug supports "block", "redact", and the detect-only "flag" action.

content_filters.description: Custom regex content filters to apply to request messages

description.example: A guardrail for limiting API usage

enable_free_model_publication.description: Whether this guardrail allows free endpoints that publish prompts.

enable_free_model_training.description: Whether this guardrail allows free endpoints that train on request data.

enable_paid_model_training.description: Whether this guardrail allows paid endpoints that train on request data.

enforce_zdr.description: Deprecated. Use enforce_zdr_anthropic, enforce_zdr_openai, enforce_zdr_google, enforce_zdr_xai, and enforce_zdr_other instead. When provided, its value is copied into any of those per-provider fields that are not explicitly specified on the request.

enforce_zdr_anthropic.description: Whether to enforce zero data retention for Anthropic models. Falls back to enforce_zdr when not provided.

enforce_zdr_google.description: Whether to enforce zero data retention for Google models. Falls back to enforce_zdr when not provided.

enforce_zdr_openai.description: Whether to enforce zero data retention for OpenAI models. Falls back to enforce_zdr when not provided.

enforce_zdr_other.description: Whether to enforce zero data retention for models that are not from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, or xAI. Falls back to enforce_zdr when not provided.

enforce_zdr_xai.description: Whether to enforce zero data retention for xAI models. Falls back to enforce_zdr when not provided.

ignored_models.description: Array of model identifiers to exclude from routing (slug or canonical_slug accepted)

ignored_providers.description: List of provider IDs to exclude from routing

include_byok_in_budgets.description: Whether BYOK (bring-your-own-key) inference spend counts toward this guardrail's limit_usd, in addition to OpenRouter credit spend. Defaults to false.

limit_usd.description: Spending limit in USD. Must be provided together with `reset_interval`: a request that sets only one of the two is rejected with a 400.

workspace_id.description: The workspace to create the guardrail in. When omitted, the guardrail is created in the default workspace; if that default has been deleted, the request returns a 400 and you must pass `workspace_id` explicitly. This only places the guardrail in the workspace; the created guardrail enforces nothing for that workspace's traffic until it is assigned to API keys or members. To restrict all traffic in a workspace, update the workspace's default guardrail instead.
